description: Returns the crystal for each placement's tropical degree after Costelloe's Complete Guide to Crystal Astrology (360 degrees, one crystal each, with page locators): Sun to Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Chiron, the Ascendant and the true (osculating) nodes, with retrograde flags, the Sun's Karmic Condition/Focus/Quest sequence, each degree's number (1-360), the zodiac birthstones, weekday stone and planet metals, the chart's colour and rock-type pattern, and what each crystal is looked to for. Every crystal carries handling, water, price and availability facts and, when it is toxic, costly or rare, a safe stand-in from the neighbouring degrees. Western tropical practice, separate from Jyotish; not a gemstone prescription.

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted
